senses.definition: A communication problem where a person seeking help (for example, from a computing helpdesk) provides misleadingly incomplete information about the source of the problem and thus receives inaccurate or unhelpful suggestions about how to fix it.

The system that determines the sex of humans, most other mammals, some insects (Drosophila), and some plants (Ginkgo), in which females have two of the same kind of sex cell (XX) and males have two distinct sex cells (XY).
The aldaric acid derived from xylose
Any of a group of methylated fatty acids present in the fungus Xylaria polymorpha
An organic reagent, most commonly used as a tetrasodium salt as an indicator for metal titrations.
An acid formed by the action of carbon dioxide and sodium on crude xylenol.
A petrified wood, consisting mostly of jasper.
A sugar acid that can be obtained by mild oxidation of xylose

An aneuploidy of the sex chromosomes in which a human male receives an extra Y chromosome, giving a total of 47 chromosomes instead of the usual 46; the condition is associated with learning difficulties and above-average height.
